cross_cutting_findings.finding: The no-regression contract has no test layer at all. Its only executable enforcement is a single 497-line script that nothing tests, nothing runs in CI, and nothing schedules. A regression in the REGRESSION GATE is therefore invisible by construction.
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: probe 1 (python walk: 0 *.py reference it) + git grep (hits only in prose docs and a claims corpus)

cross_cutting_findings.finding: Two invariants share one fail-open shape: a control value is computed, printed into the detail line, and then omitted from the ok expression. INV-3 does it with `junctions`; INV-5 does it with CTRL8812. The contract diagnoses the shape for INV-3 ('a detector that can never fire measures nothing', L250-252) and does not notice INV-5 has it too.
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: mutations M4 and M6, both green under violation, both harness-controlled

cross_cutting_findings.finding: The INV-3.J hazard is live NOW: two junctions from the quarantine into the real Chrome and Edge User Data trees still exist, and a contract run today returns SUCCESS:INV-3-crcp-quarantined with them present (the junction-aware count is 7032 >= the 7024 floor). Per the contract's own ordering rule (L267-271) the gate and the removal must ship together.
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: PowerShell ReparsePoint query and an independent python os.scandir walk, both reporting exactly 2 junctions
cross_cutting_findings.remediation_is_owner_scope: This unit is read-only and did not remove them. The contract's verbatim removal is `cmd /c rmdir <junction>` -- NEVER `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force`, which can recurse into and destroy the live profiles.

cross_cutting_findings.finding: IDENTIFIER COLLISION: the contract reserves INV-7 for a PROPOSED 'typed silence' invariant and states explicitly that none of INV-7..INV-10 is in force. enumeration_completeness.why_this_section_exists: 20 clauses were adjudicated but the mechanical scan found 28 normative-marker lines. A reader is entitled to know what happened to the other 8 rather than trusting that the enumeration was complete. Every one of the 28 is accounted for below.

'MUST NOT FIRE: no prune the disabled list, no promotion of a server to project scope' is a directive to a HUMAN/agent about what not to do, not a state predicate. Its observable half (project_scoped == 0) IS adjudicated as C-INV2-PROJECT-SCOPED-ZERO.

accounting.note: This line is the contract's own MUST FIRE: 'with a junction present ... inv3_crcp() must return FAILED. This is the known-broken state and it is the half that is missing today: no run has ever shown INV-3 red on a junction.' Mutation M4 ran exactly that test. It still does not go red.
'MUST FIRE: passed >= 861'. The floor term IS present in the ok expression at check_no_regression.py:338; what is missing is the ratchet that keeps the number honest.

accounting.reason: 'MUST NOT FIRE: do not restore the four files ... and do not delete them believing they were deliberately excluded' is a directive to a human/agent about a briefing error, not a state predicate. Its observable half (the 20-name set) IS adjudicated as C-INV6-NAME-SET.

INV-8 (PROPOSED). The contract states at L568-571 that none of INV-7..INV-10 is in force, so 'no test covers it' is the DECLARED state, not a defect. Only INV-7 is reported, because an in-force invariant has taken its identifier.

enumeration_completeness.summary: 20 of 28 marker lines are adjudicated in clause_map. The 8 exclusions are: 1 scope sentence, 2 human-procedural directives whose observable halves ARE adjudicated, 2 acceptance criteria for a patch that has not been applied, and 4 lines belonging to PROPOSED invariants the contract itself declares not in force.
enumeration_completeness.known_limit: The scan keys on the contract's own normative vocabulary (MUST FIRE / MUST STAY SILENT / MUST STAY THE SAME / MUST NOT FIRE / must gate / MUST). An obligation phrased WITHOUT one of those tokens -- e.g. the addendum's numbered prose at L485-506 -- would not be counted as a marker line, though the substantive ones there were read manually and are adjudicated (C-INV6-NAME-SET, C-INV6-FRONTMATTER-EACH-FILE).
